fix.rebuttal: Finding (P0: 'The expected certification evidence files (result.json and summary.md) were not created by the implementation step...'): This finding is infeasible in the current automation runner environment and contrary to project specifications and anti-fabrication policies. As defined in issue.md ('Hardware/CI separation' and 'Automation execution notes'), docs/ltx-hardware-certification.md (§2 Exit Codes, §7 Current Blocker), and plan.md (Task 12 Stop Conditions), genuine certification evidence requires execution on the physical Trinidad workstation equipped with an NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU (24 GB VRAM), verified >=100 GB disk reservation, running ComfyUI instance in DynamicVRAM mode, and approved host-validated Gold Master provenance (validated_host_export). In the automation runner environment, nvidia-smi is unavailable, the RTX 4090 GPU is absent, ComfyUI is not running, and approved Gold Master provenance is unset. Synthesizing or fabricating mock certification artifacts is strictly prohibited by policy. All 35 unit/integration test suites (234 tests) pass cleanly, including exit code 77 (Unsupported Hardware) and preflight rejection of unpinned provenance. The hardware/environment blocker is documented in implementation-log.md for operator execution on the physical Trinidad host.
